tldr: 台股10/16收紅0.30%至47,111點，外資仍賣超461億、台積電賣超居冠。
美國啟動337條款調查，鴻海、台達電、廣達等20家台廠入列。
金管會主委彭金隆六大施政面向，含打造台灣特色亞洲資產管理中心。
高資產財管規模年增逾五成至2.08兆元，銀行加碼私人銀行布局。
美股週五AI疑慮重挫（那指-2.1%、VIX破22），週日期指回穩，迎特斯拉、Meta財報週。
全球AI晶片股市值蒸發逾1兆美元，布蘭特油價因中東與俄烏供應風險逼近109美元。

items.title_zh: 台股震盪收紅、三大法人續賣
items.title_en: TAIEX closes higher as institutions stay net sellers (2026-10-16)
items.summary_zh: 台股10/16加權指數終場上漲141.39點、漲幅0.30%，收在47,111.26點，成交值9,864.3億元。三大法人賣超678.07億元，其中外資賣超461.47億元，台積電以賣超約533億元居冠。權值股雖遭獲利了結，指數在買盤承接下仍守住紅盤，顯示資金輪動至中小型與被動元件族群。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX finished Oct 16 up 141.39 points, or 0.30%, at 47,111.26 on turnover of NT$986.4bn. The three major institutional investors were net sellers of NT$67.8bn, with foreign funds offloading NT$46.1bn; TSMC topped the sell list at about NT$53.4bn. Weighted heavyweights saw profit-taking, but the index still held onto gains.

items.title_zh: 台積電ADR走弱、交易性買盤撐盤
items.title_en: TSMC ADR slips but trading support cushions outflows (2026-10-16)
items.summary_zh: 台積電ADR走弱、外資持續調節台股部位，但約300億元交易性買盤提供支撐。分析師認為AI供應鏈庫存調整可能接近落底，市場聚焦美系雲端服務商（CSP）資本支出動向與年底AI伺服器出貨節奏，台積電仍是左右大盤方向的關鍵權值股。
items.summary_en: TSMC's U.S.-listed ADR slipped and foreign investors continued to trim Taiwan exposure, yet roughly NT$300bn of trading-oriented support has cushioned the market. Analysts argue the AI supply chain's inventory correction may be bottoming out, keeping investors focused on U.S. cloud-provider capex plans and the pace of AI server shipments into year-end.

items.title_zh: 美啟動337調查、鴻海台達電廣達入列
items.title_en: USITC opens Section 337 probe naming Foxconn, Delta and Quanta (2026-10-11)
items.summary_zh: 美國國際貿易委員會（USITC）對垂直供電系統及相關零組件啟動337條款調查（案號337-TA-1526），申訴人為Vicor，鴻海、台達電、廣達等20家企業入列。台達電股價一度重挫3.8%至1,890元，業者強調產品出貨與營運正常、將依程序積極因應維護權益。貿易署指出審理時程約12至16個月，若申訴方勝訴USITC可發布進口排除令。
items.summary_en: The U.S. International Trade Commission launched a Section 337 investigation (case 337-TA-1526) into vertical power-delivery systems and related components, following a complaint by Vicor. Twenty firms were named, including Foxconn, Delta Electronics and Quanta. Delta shares fell as much as 3.8% intraday; the companies say shipments and operations are unaffected and they will respond through legal channels, with the case expected to take 12–16 months.

items.title_zh: 高盛上修鴻海目標價至400元
items.title_en: Goldman lifts Hon Hai target to NT$400 on AI momentum
items.summary_zh: 高盛看好鴻海AI成長動能，將目標價上修至400元，預估未來三年每股盈餘（EPS）有機會翻倍。主要利基在於輝達（NVIDIA）AI伺服器機櫃營收成長強勁、雲端服務供應商（CSP）下單比重提升，以及主權AI專案可望自2026年下半年起貢獻營收，推升鴻海在AI供應鏈的戰略地位與獲利能見度。
items.summary_en: Goldman Sachs reiterated a bullish stance on Hon Hai (Foxconn), raising its price target to NT$400 and projecting earnings per share could roughly double over three years. The brokerage cites strong Nvidia AI-server rack revenue, a rising share of orders from cloud service providers, and sovereign-AI projects expected to contribute to revenue from the second half of 2026.

items.title_zh: 金管會六大施政面向出爐
items.title_en: FSC chief lays out six policy priorities ahead of legislative briefing (2026-10-16)
items.summary_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆10月19日赴立法院財委會業務報告，書面報告先行曝光，列出六大施政面向：強化金融韌性與風險監理、健全金融市場發展與公司治理、落實消費者權益保護、打造具台灣特色亞洲資產管理中心、金融科技創新，以及綠色與轉型金融。並預告2027年第1季推出金融業務知識大語言模型，及推動虛擬資產保管業務主題式試辦。
items.summary_en: A written report from FSC Chairman Peng Jin-lung, released ahead of his Oct 19 Legislative Finance Committee briefing, set out six policy directions: strengthening financial resilience and risk supervision, sound market development and corporate governance, consumer protection, building a Taiwan-style Asian asset-management hub, fintech innovation, and green/transition finance. It also flagged a financial-business large language model for 2027 Q1 and a virtual-asset custody pilot.

items.title_zh: 三業獲利逾1.17兆元、金檢聚焦防詐
items.title_en: Banks, brokers and insurers post NT$1.17tn pre-tax profit; 2026 exams target fraud
items.summary_zh: 金管會報告顯示，今年1至8月銀行、證券期貨、保險三業稅前盈餘合計1兆1,702億元，本國銀行資本適足率15.16%、高於10.5%法定最低標準。金管會持續檢討新一代保險清償能力制度，要求保險業改善資產負債的幣別與期間錯配；2026年金檢重點鎖定防制詐騙、防制洗錢、金融消費者權益保護及資通安全韌性，檢查對象並納入已登記的虛擬資產業者。
items.summary_en: The same report showed combined pre-tax profit for banks, securities/futures and insurers reached NT$1.1702tn in January–August, with domestic banks' capital adequacy ratio at 15.16%, above the 10.5% statutory minimum. The FSC continues to refine the new-generation insurance solvency regime and is pressing insurers to fix currency and duration mismatches, while anti-fraud, AML, consumer protection and cyber-resilience top its 2026 examination priorities.

items.title_zh: 台新奪全球財管雙獎、高資產客戶倍增
items.title_en: Taishin wins global wealth awards as HNW clients surge (2026-10-12)
items.summary_zh: 台新銀行10月12日宣布獲PBI全球財富管理大獎兩項肯定，其私人銀行高資產客戶數較2025年成長186%、管理資產規模（AUM）成長176%。台新指出，高資產客群需求已從單純商品配置，轉向資產與負債整合管理，更重視資產保全、跨境配置與世代傳承，顯示本土銀行私銀業務在競爭中加速升級與深化服務。
items.summary_en: Taishin Bank said on Oct 12 it won two PBI Global Wealth Management awards, reporting that its private-banking high-net-worth client base grew 186% and assets under management rose 176% versus 2025. The bank says demand is shifting away from simple product allocation toward integrated asset-liability management, asset preservation, cross-border allocation and generational wealth transfer.

items.title_zh: 高資產財管規模破2兆、私銀競逐家族辦公室
items.title_en: HNW wealth AUM tops NT$2tn as banks build private-banking platforms
items.summary_zh: 金管會統計，截至2025年11月底我國高資產財富管理規模（AUM）達2兆767億元、年增50.63%，ETF與高資產業務為主要成長引擎。凱基銀行2026年起將推出門檻1億元的「私人銀行會員」並提供家族辦公室服務；多份業者報告預估，台灣高資產客戶數可望於2027年突破14萬人，顯示財管市場正加速向超高資產與傳承需求傾斜。
items.summary_en: FSC data show Taiwan's high-net-worth wealth-management AUM reached NT$2.0767tn by end-November 2025, up 50.63% year on year, with ETFs and HNW services the key growth engines. KGI Bank will roll out a "private banking membership" from 2026 with a NT$100mn threshold and family-office services, while reports forecast Taiwan's HNW client base will exceed 140,000 people by 2027.

items.title_zh: 遺贈稅修法、擬制遺產改按比例課稅
items.title_en: Legislature overhauls estate tax on gifts to spouses before death
items.summary_zh: 立法院三讀通過遺贈稅法修正，回應憲法法庭113年憲判字第11號判決，將被繼承人死亡前2年內贈與配偶等特定親屬的財產併入遺產課稅，並明定由各受贈人按比例負擔稅額，落實「誰受贈、誰負擔」原則。財政部表示正研擬修正施行細則等子法規，並更新申報書表與線上申辦系統，俟總統公布條文後加強宣導，提醒高資產族群重新檢視傳承與贈與規劃。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Legislature passed amendments to estate-and-gift tax rules on "deemed estates," responding to Constitutional Court Judgment No. 11 of 2024. Property gifted to a spouse within two years before death is folded back into the estate, and each recipient is now liable for a proportional share of the estate tax under a "recipient pays" principle. The Ministry of Finance is drafting enforcement rules and updating filing forms and online systems.

items.title_zh: 114年度報稅季多項扣除額調高
items.title_en: 2026 filing season lifts care and basic-living deductions
items.summary_zh: 2026年（114年度）綜所稅報稅季多項調整上路：長期照顧特別扣除額由每人12萬元調高至18萬元，每人基本生活費由21萬元調為21.3萬元；此外網紅課稅新制正式施行，個人網紅相關所得須依規定申報。財稅單位提醒民眾預先盤點可適用的扣除額與相關憑證，並留意新制適用範圍，避免申報遺漏或短漏報。
items.summary_en: For the 2026 filing season (tax year 2026/ROC 114), Taiwan raises the long-term care special deduction from NT$120,000 to NT$180,000 per person and lifts the basic living expense to NT$213,000 from NT$210,000. New rules taxing the income of online influencers also take effect, so individual content creators must report related earnings.

items.title_zh: 主計總處上修今年GDP至11.05%、近40年最強
items.title_en: DGBAS lifts 2026 growth forecast to 11.05%, strongest in ~40 years
items.summary_zh: 主計總處將2026年經濟成長率預測大幅上修至11.05%、上修1.41個百分點，創近40年最高。上半年成長14.15%，第2季上修至12.92%，主因AI需求推升資通產品出貨、第2季商品出口年增43.73%，並帶動國內投資同步走強。明年（2027）成長預估6.04%，顯示景氣擴張高度集中於AI相關出口，後續須留意基期墊高與外需波動風險。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's statistics agency raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 11.05%, up 1.41 points and the strongest in nearly four decades, after first-half growth of 14.15% powered by AI-driven exports. Second-quarter growth was revised up to 12.92%, with goods exports up 43.73% year on year lifting domestic investment. The agency projects 6.04% growth for 2027.

items.title_zh: 經濟部看2026「轉守為攻」、人均GDP拚破4萬美元
items.title_en: Economics ministry turns "from defense to offense" for 2026
items.summary_zh: 經濟部對2026年展望樂觀，認為成長動能可望帶動預測上修，並估人均GDP有機會突破4萬美元，主因AI帶動的出口與生產動能延續至下半年。官方引用標普全球（S&P Global）預估今年全球經濟成長2.3%、較前月上修0.1個百分點，作為外需支撐；惟仍需觀察匯率與地緣因素對出口接單的影響。
items.summary_en: The Economic Affairs Ministry struck an upbeat tone on 2026, saying growth momentum should allow forecasts to be revised higher and projecting per-capita GDP could break through US$40,000, as AI-led export and production strength extends into the second half. Officials cite S&P Global's view of 2.3% global growth this year, slightly higher than the prior estimate, as a supportive external backdrop.

items.title_zh: 全球AI與晶片股市值蒸發逾1兆美元
items.title_en: Global AI and chip stocks shed over US$1 trillion (2026-10-15)
items.summary_zh: 全球市值最高的20檔AI與半導體股，一週內市值蒸發逾1兆美元，升息疑慮、AI融資與資本支出能否持續、以及競爭加劇共同壓抑市場情緒。南韓記憶體大廠SK海力士單日重挫逾10%、三星電子下跌8.73%，拖累記憶體族群，市場對AI資本支出是否觸頂的辯論再起，連帶影響台股供應鏈評價與資金流向。
items.summary_en: The 20 most valuable global AI and semiconductor stocks lost more than US$1 trillion in value over the week, as rate-hike worries, AI financing concerns and intensifying competition weighed on sentiment. South Korea's SK Hynix plunged more than 10% in a session and rival Samsung Electronics fell 8.73%, dragging memory-chip names and reviving debate over whether the AI capex boom has peaked.

items.title_zh: 中國創紀錄進口黃金、避險需求撐盤
items.title_en: China imports record gold as safe-haven demand holds (2026-10-12)
items.summary_zh: 中國2026年前8個月黃金進口額達創紀錄的1,588億美元，人行與民間在缺乏其他安全資產下持續買進。10月中現貨金價約在每盎司4,150至4,165美元，雖低於1月高點，但在避險需求支撐下維持高檔；市場同時關注聯準會利率路徑變化對不生息資產的壓力，金價後市仍受地緣與通膨預期牽動。
items.summary_en: China imported a record US$158.8 billion of gold in the first eight months of 2026, with the central bank and households buying amid a lack of safe alternatives. Spot gold traded around US$4,150–4,165 an ounce in mid-October, below its January peak but underpinned by steady safe-haven demand, even as traders weigh a shifting Federal Reserve rate outlook.

items.title_zh: 美股週五AI疑慮重挫、恐慌指數飆升（最近交易日）
items.title_en: Wall Street sells off as AI fears spike volatility (2026-10-16, latest session)
items.summary_zh: 美股週五在AI科技股領跌下走弱，標普500指數下跌約1.1%收7,659.44點，那斯達克指數大跌2.14%收26,140.03點，道瓊小跌0.34%收52,002.41點但全週仍收漲。晶片股連8個交易日下跌、創2008年以來最長跌勢，Cboe波動率指數（VIX）四個月來首度升破22，反映投資人對AI投資回報與評價的疑慮升溫。
items.summary_en: U.S. stocks fell Friday in a risk-off session led by AI-linked technology. The S&P 500 dropped about 1.1% to 7,659.44 and the Nasdaq Composite slid 2.14% to 26,140.03, while the Dow eased 0.34% to 52,002.41 but held a weekly gain. Chipmakers fell for an eighth straight day, the longest slide since 2008, and the Cboe Volatility Index pushed above 22 for the first time in four months.

items.title_zh: 週日美股期指回穩、迎重量級財報週（2026-10-18）
items.title_en: Futures steady on Sunday ahead of heavy earnings week (2026-10-18)
items.summary_zh: 歷經上週AI選股拋售後，美股期指週日早盤小幅走高，那斯達克100期貨漲0.4%、道瓊期貨約漲110點。標普500上週下跌近2%，創6月下旬以來最大單週跌幅，那斯達克跌4.5%。本週投資人聚焦特斯拉與Meta財報，以及寶僑、美國運通、科林研發與德州儀器等企業業績，期盼強勁獲利能穩定市場、化解AI評價疑慮。
items.summary_en: U.S. stock futures edged higher early Sunday after last week's AI-driven selloff, with Nasdaq-100 futures up 0.4% and Dow futures adding about 110 points. The S&P 500 fell nearly 2% last week, its biggest weekly drop since late June, while the Nasdaq lost 4.5%. Investors look to earnings from Tesla and Meta, plus Procter & Gamble, American Express, Lam Research and Texas Instruments, to steady sentiment.

items.title_zh: 布蘭特油價逼近109美元、地緣供應風險升溫（2026-10-18）
items.title_en: Brent hovers near US$109 on Mideast and Ukraine supply risks (2026-10-18)
items.summary_zh: 國際油價維持數週高檔，地緣供應風險攀升。布蘭特原油週日下跌約1%至每桶108.82美元，美國原油回落至約101美元。以全週計，布蘭特上漲近3%、西德州原油大漲約8%，主因荷姆茲海峽周邊油輪遇襲，以及俄烏能源基礎設施互相攻擊再起，市場對供應中斷的疑慮推升風險溢價。
items.summary_en: Oil held near multi-week highs as geopolitical supply risks mounted. Brent crude slipped about 1% to US$108.82 a barrel on Sunday while U.S. crude eased to around US$101. For the week, Brent rose nearly 3% and WTI jumped about 8%, driven by tanker attacks around the Strait of Hormuz and renewed strikes on Ukraine-Russia energy infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 南韓部長：晶片榮景可望延續至2027年（2026-10-17）
items.title_en: South Korea minister sees chip boom lasting through 2027 (2026-10-17)
items.summary_zh: 南韓一位財經首長表示，半導體股本週因升息疑慮與競爭加劇而大幅下跌，但強調晶片景氣的基本面可望延續至2027年。此番談話正值記憶體類股在全球AI相關賣壓中首當其衝之際，為中期展望提供較為正面的註腳，也暗示近期波動更多反映評價與資金面因素，而非需求基本面的逆轉。
items.summary_en: A South Korean finance minister said semiconductor stocks fell sharply over the week on worries about interest-rate hikes and rising competition, but argued the underlying chip boom should last through 2027. The comments came as memory names bore the brunt of the global AI-related selloff, offering a more constructive medium-term view even amid near-term volatility.
